info.title: Authorisation API
info.description:
# Overview The Authorisation API provides the authentication and consent flows required to securely access Investec APIs using the **OAuth 2.0 framework**. Authentication requires both **OAuth 2.0 credentials** (`client_id` and `client_secret`) and an additional **x-api-key**, generated on Investec Online, which is used to identify your application and enforce the appropriate scopes. With this API, you can: - Obtain an access token using the **client credentials** grant type - Authorise users via **3-legged OAuth (authorization code flow)** - Exchange authorisation codes for access and refresh tokens - Refresh expired access tokens This API underpins all Investec API interactions by ensuring that requests are **secure, authenticated, and scoped appropriately** based on the permissions assigned to your application and API key. # Quickstart (cURL)
View Quickstart - Investec API authentication uses **OAuth 2.0 client credentials** (`client_id` and `client_secret`), with the addition of an `x-api-key`. - Log in to Investec Online to get your `client_id` and `client_secret` and to generate your `x-api key` with the scopes you require. **1. Get an access token** - To get an access token, you must exchange your `client_id`, `client_secret` and `x-api key` for the token ```bash curl --location 'https://openapi.investec.com/identity/v2/oauth2/token' \ --header 'x-api-key: <>' \ --header 'Authorization: Basic <>' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \ --data-urlencode 'grant_type=client_credentials' ``` **Headers explained:** - `x-api-key`: API key generated on Investec Online - `Authorization`: Base64-encoded `client_id:client_secret`. Take your `client_id` and `client_secret` and base64 encode them to provide a value for basic authorisation. - `Content-Type`: Indicates the request body format **2. Use the token for all API requests** - Use the access token that you receive in all subsequent API requests - Access tokens are **valid for 30 minutes** and must be refreshed when expired ```bash curl --location 'https://openapi.investec.com/...' \ --header 'Authorization: Bearer <>' ``` **Notes** - Ensure your API key has the required scopes - you can set these when you create the key on Investec Online.

tags.name: API Authorisation using client credentials
tags.description: Obtain access tokens using the client credentials grant type, which requires both OAuth 2.0 credentials and an x-api-key.

tags.name: 3 Legged OAuth
tags.description: Authenticate users via the authorisation code flow, allowing third-party applications to access user data with their consent.

post.description: Get an access token (bearer) so that you can call Investec APIs. This endpoint uses the client credentials grant type, which requires both OAuth 2.0 credentials and an x-api-key.

x-codeSamples.label: HTTP
x-codeSamples.source:
POST /identity/v2/oauth2/token HTTP/1.1
Host: openapi.investec.com
x-api-key: <<your_api_key>>
Authorization: Basic <<base64(client_id:client_secret)>>
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials

400.description: Bad Request - The requested operation will not be carried out

401.description: Unauthorized - The requested operation was refused access

500.description: Internal Server Error - The requested operation failed to execute

get.description: Get redirected to the Investec consent screen. This endpoint is used in the 3-legged OAuth flow and requires third parties to provide the scope, client_id, redirect_uri and response_type as query parameters.

400.description: Bad Request - The requested operation will not be carried out

401.description: Unauthorized - The requested operation was refused access

500.description: Internal Server Error - The requested operation failed to execute

post.description: Generate an access token (bearer) by exchanging an authorisation code. This endpoint is used in the 3-legged OAuth flow and requires third parties to provide the authorisation code, redirect URI and grant type in the request body.

x-codeSamples.label: HTTP
x-codeSamples.source:
POST /identity/v2/oauth2/token HTTP/1.1
Host: openapi.investec.com
Authorization: Basic <<base64(client_id:client_secret)>>
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=authorization_code&code=<<your_authorisation_code>>&redirect_uri=https://app.redirect.co.za

400.description: Bad Request - The requested operation will not be carried out

401.description: Unauthorized - The requested operation was refused access

500.description: Internal Server Error - The requested operation failed to execute

code.description: The authorisation code returned from the consent flow

redirect_uri.description: The redirect URI used in the authorisation request.

post.description: Refresh a bearer token using a refresh token. This endpoint is used in the 3-legged OAuth flow and requires third parties to provide the refresh token and grant type in the request body.

x-codeSamples.label: HTTP
x-codeSamples.source:
POST /identity/v2/oauth2/token HTTP/1.1
Host: openapi.investec.com
Authorization: Basic <<base64(client_id:client_secret)>>
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=refresh_token&refresh_token=<<your_refresh_token>>

400.description: Bad Request - The requested operation will not be carried out

401.description: Unauthorized - The requested operation was refused access

500.description: Internal Server Error - The requested operation failed to execute

refresh_token.description: The refresh token used to obtain a new access token.

access_token.description: The access token used to call Investec APIs

expires_in.description: The lifetime in seconds of the access token

scope.description: The scope associated with the access token
